title: Walks tab never refetches on focus: a newly added pet or walk does not show up, and no pull-to-refresh
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/walks/page.tsx:207-210 (refetch on each mount/navigation; the route remounts)
current_ios: Expo Router tabs stay mounted, and useWalksData only fetches when `user` changes. A new user who creates their first pet on the Pets tab and then opens Walks still sees the 0-pet empty state until the app restarts. A walk deleted or added by another family member, or a pet's walk goal edited on the Pets tab, is also not reflected. `todayIdx` is memoised once with [] (use-walks-data.ts:106), and today/week stats only recompute when `walks` changes, so if the app stays in memory past midnight the week strip and dial show yesterday as today. Other tabs (index.tsx:89, pets.tsx:159) have RefreshControl; walks does not.
target: Fresh data every time the tab gains focus, pull-to-refresh like the other tabs, and day-dependent stats recomputed when the day rolls over.
fix_plan: In walks.tsx, use `useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { void data.refresh(); }, [data.refresh]))` from expo-router. Make it a silent refresh: add a `refreshing` flag in the hook so focus and pull refreshes do not flip `loading` to true and blank the list. Add `refreshControl={<RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={refresh} tintColor={colors.brand} />}` to the ScrollView (walks.tsx:108). In use-walks-data.ts, replace the [] memo for todayIdx with a `dayKey` state that updates on AppState 'active' (`new Date().toDateString()`), and add dayKey to the deps of todayIdx, todayProgress, weekDayFlags, weekKm, weekCount and weeklyAvgMin.

title: Recent-walk row is the old WalkCard layout: no delete, no walker line, no photo thumbnail, wrong icons and time format
current_ios: iOS WalkRow ports the retired WalkCard: radius.lg 14, padding 16, a separate 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' date line, an emoji grid (📏 ⏱️ ⭐), a lucide Footprints icon, and relative time shown only as '今天' or 'M/D'. Several web features are missing: (1) the Trash2 delete button with a confirm dialog (iOS lib/walks.ts has no deleteWalk at all, so walks cannot be deleted on iOS); (2) the walker attribution line (18px avatar + Walks.page.walkedBy); (3) the 36px photo thumbnail with a count badge that opens a lightbox.
target: Web WalkRow: an article with rounded-2xl (16px), 1px hairline border, white card, paddingH 14 / paddingV 12, near-flat shadow, gap 12. Left: a 40px disc (manual: bgAlt + lucide Hand 18 in ink2; GPS: brandTint + the inline paw SVG 18 in brandDeep). Middle: pet name 14/600 ink (truncated) and, aligned right on the same baseline, relative time 12 ink3. Below that, a 12.5px ink2 row of Route 13 ink3 + 'x.xx km', Clock 13 ink3 + 'N min', and Star 12 + score.toFixed(1) in 600 brandDeep. Then, when a walker name exists, Avatar 18 + t('Walks.page.walkedBy',{name}) in 11.5 ink3. Right: an optional 36px photo thumb (radius 8, hairline, with a count badge when there are 2+ photos) and a 32px Trash2 16 button in ink3.
fix_plan: 1) apps/ios/src/lib/walks.ts: add `export async function deleteWalk(walkId: string) { await firestore().collection('walks').doc(walkId).delete(); }`. The existing rules already allow delete by the personal owner or a family member. 2) Rewrite walk-row.tsx with props `{ walk, onDelete }`. Move the Paw SVG out of walks-week-strip.tsx into a shared `components/walks/paw-icon.tsx` and use it for GPS walks. Use lucide-react-native Hand, Route, Clock, Star and Trash2. Use `relativeTime(walk.startedAt)` from '@/lib/format' (closest helper to formatDistanceToNow). For the walker line use `<Avatar name={walkerName} photoURL={walk.walkerPhotoURL} size={18} />` and `t('Walks.page.walkedBy',{name})`. For photos, render a Pressable thumbnail with expo-image and open `PhotoLightbox` from '@/components/feed/photo-lightbox' (props photos, initialIndex 0, open, onClose); its a11y label is t('PhotoLightbox.counter',{current:1,total}). Give the delete button hitSlop to reach a 44pt target, accessibilityLabel t('Common.delete'), and onPress=onDelete. 3) walks.tsx: add handleDelete(w) using `Alert.alert(t('Common.delete'), `${w.distanceKm.toFixed(2)} km · ${w.durationMin.toFixed(0)} min`, [{text:t('Common.cancel'),style:'cancel'},{text:t('Common.delete'),style:'destructive',onPress: async()=>{ await deleteWalk(w.walkId); await data.refresh(); }}])`, with a try/catch that shows Walks.core.saveFailed or a generic alert. Pass `onDelete={() => handleDelete(w)}`.

title: Manual walk dialog: no start/end time pickers, different validation, hard-coded copy, flat brand Save button, no keyboard avoidance
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/manual-walk-dialog.tsx:37-75 (start defaults to now-1h, end to now, duration auto-derived), 81-90 (pet/distance/duration required, end > start), 122-201
current_ios: No start/end inputs: startedAt is computed as now − duration, so past walks cannot be back-dated. That is the main purpose of '補登', and the comment claiming datetimepicker is a new dep is outdated (@react-native-community/datetimepicker 8.2.0 is installed). Duration defaults to '30' rather than being derived from start/end. Distance is optional and 0 is allowed (web requires > 0). All labels and errors are hard-coded zh. Save is a solid colors.brand pill, while design-system primary is the btn-mango gradient with white text. The custom Modal has no KeyboardAvoidingView, so the keyboard covers notes and the buttons. The backdrop can dismiss the dialog mid-save. There is no 'noPet' state when pets is empty.
target: Web form order: Pet, then Start | End, then Distance (km) | Duration (min), then Notes, then error, then Cancel (ghost) / Save (primary btn-mango). Start defaults to now−1h, end to now, and duration auto-recomputes when the times change. Same validation as web.
fix_plan: Rebuild on the shared `Sheet` primitive (components/ui/Sheet.tsx, which already includes KeyboardAvoidingView), or wrap the existing body in KeyboardAvoidingView behavior='padding'. Add startedAt/endedAt Date state, reset on open to (now−60min, now). Render two pressable fields showing local 'YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm' that open `DateTimePicker` (mode='datetime', display='spinner' or 'compact' on iOS, maximumDate=new Date()). When start or end changes and end > start, set duration = round((end−start)/60000). Validation: require petId, distance > 0 and duration > 0, else the required-fields error; require end > start, else the end-after-start error. Pass startedAt/endedAt through to createWalk. Labels: t('Walks.manual.title'|'pet'|'start'|'end'|'distance'|'duration'|'notes'), t('Walks.manual.noPet') when pets is empty, and t('Common.cancel')/t('Common.save'). Use `<Button variant='ghost'>` for Cancel and `<Button variant='primary' loading={saving}>` for Save (the gradient). Disable backdrop dismissal while saving. Keep the iOS-only score preview only behind a new i18n key, or remove it.
needs_new_i18n_keys: Walks.manual.errRequired = 請填寫寵物、距離、時長 | Please fill in pet, distance and duration
Walks.manual.errEndBeforeStart = 結束時間需晚於開始時間 | End time must be after start time
Walks.manual.scorePreview = 預估分數 +{score} | Estimated score +{score}
